name: slacklens
description: Personal Slack triage dashboard for Claude Code. Semantic task inference: each thread card shows a one-line "what to do" derived by Claude from the whole thread (Hinglish supported) instead of raw Slack messages. Four-tier priority scoring — a priority contact's direct message outranks a fresh casual ping. Cache schema v3 with per-thread inference cached by last-message-ts. Pinned search limits, permalink dedupe, atomic cache writes with backup + suspicious-refresh guard. DELTA refresh. Stale-cache warnings. Token-cost instrumentation in the refresh log.
